│ What should happen to the paused desktop work (six areas built in separate
│ worktrees, based on a 399-commits-old main)?

❯ 1. Keep the worktrees (Recommended)
     Leave the six worktrees and their branches in place so the work can be
     resumed later.
  2. Rebase onto current main
     Update each worktree's branch onto the current main before continuing
     the paused work.
  3. Type something.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  4. Chat about this

Enter to select · Tab/Arrow keys to navigate · Esc to cancel
